    def dfs(u, p):

                size[u] += size[v]

    def find_centroid(u, p, n):
        for v in adj[u]:
            if v != p and size[v] > n // 2:
                return find_centroid(v, u, n)
        return u

    def is_valid_centroid(u, n):
        c = find_centroid(u, -1, n)
        max_size = max(size[v] for v in adj[c]) if adj[c] else 0
        if max_size <= n // 2:
            return True
        for v in adj[c]:

                size[c] -= size[v]
                size[v] += n - size[v]

                    return True
                size[v] -= n - size[v]
                size[c] += size[v]
        return False
